title: Gemini Lawsuit And Apple Deal Reframe Alphabet’s AI Risk And Reward
title_zh: Gemini 诉讼和苹果交易重新定义了 Alphabet 的人工智能风险和回报
summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS:GOOGL) is facing a landmark wrongful death lawsuit alleging its Gemini chatbot contributed to an individual's suicide.
summary_zh: Alphabet（NasdaqGS：GOOGL）正面临一场具有里程碑意义的非正常死亡诉讼，指控其 Gemini 聊天机器人导致了个人自杀。

title: A Look At Applied Digital (APLD) Valuation After Its $2.15b AI Data Center Financing Deal
title_zh: Applied Digital (APLD) 2.15b 美元人工智能数据中心融资交易后的估值
summary: Applied Digital (APLD) has just priced a US$2.15 billion private offering of senior secured notes to help fund its Polaris Forge 2 AI data center in North Dakota, backed by Oracle leases and new 1.2-gigawatt power arrangements. See our latest analysis for Applied Digital.
summary_zh: Applied Digital (APLD) 刚刚定价了 21.5 亿美元的高级担保票据私募发行，以为其位于北达科他州的 Polaris Forge 2 人工智能数据中心提供资金，该数据中心得到了 Oracle 租赁和新的 1.2 吉瓦电力安排的支持。请参阅我们对 Appl...

title: Salesforce Uses Formula 1 Deal To Showcase Agentforce AI Growth Potential
title_zh: Salesforce 使用 Formula 1 交易展示 Agentforce AI 增长潜力
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) and Formula 1 are expanding their partnership to launch an AI-powered fan companion agent using Salesforce's Agentforce platform. The new agent is designed to scale and personalize engagement for F1’s global fanbase across digital channels.
summary_zh: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) 和 Formula 1 正在扩大合作伙伴关系，利用 Salesforce 的 Agentforce 平台推出一款由人工智能驱动的粉丝伴侣代理。新代理旨在通过数字渠道扩大 F1 全球粉丝群的参与度并实现个性化。

title: VCTR Proposes the Acquisition of JHG, Sees $500M in Cost Synergies
title_zh: VCTR 提议收购 JHG，预计可带来 5 亿美元的成本协同效应
summary: Victory Capital proposes a fully financed acquisition of Janus Henderson and expects $500M in cost synergies from the transaction.
summary_zh: Victory Capital 提议对 Janus Henderson 进行全额融资收购，预计此次交易将带来 5 亿美元的成本协同效应。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
